0.1.1:
## Changes

- Added encrypted 3DS cartridge loading using console-supplied AES keys and seed data.
- Added key and seed imports in Settings and clearer game-load error messages.

## Known limitations

- Some encrypted titles need both AES keys and a seed database. Use your own console data.
- This historical build also includes experimental Switch support, which requires JIT.
0.1.2:
## Changes

- Fixed the 3DS key and seed import directory and added migration from the previous location without overwriting existing files.
- Added the Tandem app icon.
- Added manual cover-image selection and removal from the game library context menu.

## Known limitations

- This historical build also includes experimental Switch support, which requires JIT.
0.1.3:
## Changes

- Fixed loading for decrypted 3DS dumps whose headers still mark them as encrypted.
- Verify the plaintext extended header before deciding whether decryption is required, preventing double decryption of verified plaintext dumps.

## Known limitations

- This change does not make every game dump compatible; damaged headers and missing data can still prevent loading.
- This historical build also includes experimental Switch support, which requires JIT.
0.1.4:
## Changes

- Fixed a stale shutdown signal that could immediately end a second 3DS session after exiting the first game.
- Clear pending core signals during shutdown.
- Native IPA filenames now include the version, starting with `tandemv0.1.4.ipa`.

## Known limitations

- Restart behavior and game compatibility still require physical-device testing.
- This historical build also includes experimental Switch support, which requires JIT.
0.1.5:
## Changes

- Added persistent controller-button remapping, analog-stick swapping, and a reset-to-defaults option in Settings.
- Added System, Dark, and Light appearance choices.
- Improved library text and touch-control contrast for light mode.

## Known limitations

- Controller assignments apply to both systems and take effect when starting a game. Per-game profiles are not included.
- This historical build also includes experimental Switch support, which requires JIT.
0.1.6:
## Changes

- Introduced emerald and charcoal styling, including emerald touch-control feedback.
- Added a Continue Playing card for the most recently played game.
- Added persistent favorites and a favorites-only library filter. Touch and hold a game to add or remove it.

## Known limitations

- Continue Playing launches the game; it does not automatically restore an emulator save state.
- This is the first stage of the UI redesign. This historical build still includes experimental Switch support, which requires JIT.
0.2.1:
## Changes

- Made the app and native IPA 3DS-only: removed Switch emulation, imports, settings, native helper code, and build dependencies.
- Preserve existing Switch game and system files on-device, while hiding unsupported titles from the playable library.
- Fixed IPA packaging, which still tried to verify exports from the removed Switch core after Xcode had successfully compiled the app.
- Retained automated library, simulator, and release validation.

## Known limitations

- Preserved Switch files cannot be played in this version.
- Save states are not included until v0.3.0.
0.3.0:
## Changes

- Added three 3DS save-state slots with timestamps, accessible from the tray icon in the player toolbar.
- Pause the game while managing states, with confirmation before replacing a slot or loading old progress.
- Run save-state requests on the emulation worker and reject missing or incompatible states before loading.
- Write to a temporary file and replace the old slot only after successful writing, flushing, and closing.
- Added regression checks for worker-thread requests, session behavior, and preserving existing slots after file-write failures.

## Known limitations

- Game-specific save/load behavior still needs physical-device testing; automated checks do not establish retail-game compatibility.
- Save states are separate from normal in-game saves and may become incompatible after core updates. Keep using in-game saves.
- Rewind and automatic save-state restoration are not included.
0.4.0:
## Changes

- Added stacked, side-by-side, and top-screen-focus presets in the player's layout menu.
- Added independent portrait and landscape settings for screen size, screen gap, touch-control size, and opacity.
- Move the left, right, and menu control groups using a draggable preview or position sliders. Hide touch controls when using a controller, and reset each orientation independently.
- Preserve the existing Metal layers when changing layouts, and notify the core when either screen's drawable size changes.

## Known limitations

- This version moves control groups; individual button placement is not included.
- Layout changes pause the game. Close the menu and resume when ready.
- The user reported passing the v0.3.0 save-state checklist on their phone. The new layout options still need physical-device testing; automated checks do not establish compatibility with every game or device.
